messages:
sam: Heads-up — I'm proposing a small change to the GPU fleet telemetry envelope to reduce egress and meet the new budget cap. Suggesting per-region adaptive sampling + pseudonymize GPU node identifiers before they leave the fleet.

maya: Can you sketch the sampling rules? we need to keep enough fidelity for perf regression detection. :thinking_face: 

sam: Rough plan:
- Default sampling: 5% full JSON for all regions.
- Hotspot sampling: 100% for nodes with 5xx rate > 0.5% over 15m window.
- Region override: us-west-2 & eu-central: 10% baseline due to higher traffic. ap-south (experimental): 2% to reduce egress while we canary.
- Pseudonymization: replace gpu_node_id with stable hash per-region (sha256 truncated). keep original only in private logs retained on cluster.

alex: That sounds reasonable. How does this interact with the existing JSON schema? we can't break dashboards.

sam: Minimal schema tweak: add telemetry.meta.sample_rate and telemetry.meta.node_id_hash. Example snippet:```json
{"telemetry": {"meta": {"sample_rate": "0.05", "node_id_hash": "ab12cd34..."}, "metrics": {...}}}```
No field renames, only additions. Dashboards should fallback to metrics.* keys as before.

li: We need to be explicit about PII. gpu_node_id is not user PII but can be mapped to datacenter racks in extreme cases. Ops/legal asked for pseudonymization, not full redaction. Are we ok with storing node_id_hash in hosted logs?

jordan: Legal OK'd pseudonym + HMAC with region secret. That avoids cross-region correlation without a secret. We'll need a key rotation plan.

natalie: Action item: add key rotation to the runbook and ensure rotation doesn't break historical correlation for rollback investigations.

sam: Noted. Also want to tune Prometheus alerting:
- gpu_panic_cpu_usage (current: 95% over 3m) -> proposal: 92% over 5m on Dedicated pools to reduce false positives during short spikes.
- gpu_kv_cache_miss_rate alert -> lower threshold for ap-south since sampling is lower there.

maya: Can you quantify expected savings if we do the 5% -> adaptive plan? CFO asked.

sam: Back-of-envelope: fleet telemetry egress ~ 7 TB/day. Adaptive sampling reduces that ~30% => ~2.1 TB/day less -> ~$3.6k/mo savings on logging egress. plus less downstream indexing costs maybe another ~$1.5k/mo. estimate total ~5k/mo. We'll monitor for missed regressions.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] sam pushed telemetry-sampling-v1 to staging (sha: d4f7c9). CI: green. Canary flag set for ap-south.

alex: Nice. Let's canary in ap-south for 48h then roll to us-west-2. Also want a Grafana dashboard with sampling-adjusted baselines so alerts don't regress because of fewer samples.

sam: I'll add a sampling-adjusted series using 'telemetry.meta.sample_rate' to scale rates back up for baselining (heuristic: divide counts by sample_rate). Will add a note to dashboards.

li: For the pseudonymization function, please use HMAC-SHA256(region_secret, node_id) and truncate to 12 chars. Documented in code and runbook.

jordan: Also add an eval for regression detection sensitivity: run synthetic perf anomalies against 5% vs adaptive to ensure we keep >95% detection recall for common faults.

sam: Good call. I'll coordinate with eng-ml to run the eval.

natalie: Who owns the rollout schedule and SLO changes? we need to update the SLO dashboard owners and inform support.

maya: Ops oncall owners (sam + alex) to do canary and roll; eng-ml for eval; observability for dashboard updates (li). I'll draft the announcement.

sam: Plan timeline:
- Today: merge and deploy to staging.
- 48h: canary in ap-south.
- After canary + eval results: roll to us-west-2 and eu-central (7 days).
- 30 days: review detection metrics and cost delta, revert or fine-tune if needed.

ops-bot: [incident-bot] Reminder: notify oncall@redwood if gpu_panic_cpu_usage fires during canary.

alex: Quick checklist for the PR: code changes + schema docs + runbook updates + prometheus alert tweaks + grafana dashboard update + cost estimate. I'll review PR tonight. :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks all. Posting PR link here when ready.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] staged telemetry-sampling-v1 promoted to canary (ap-south) at 2026-03-18T16:21:42Z.

sam: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/telemetry/pull/421 -- includes tests and migration notes.

maya: I'll post a short note in #general about the expected console changes and who to ping if alerts act up.

jordan: One last thought: add a small cache of full-node dumps when hotspot triggers (keep last 10 per node, rotate) so we still get rich context for debugging without continuous egress.

sam: Done in the PR (hotspot_dumps: 10). That data stays on-cluster and is accessible via oncall runbook steps.

natalie: Thanks. If canary looks good, please remember to update the billing dashboard and tag the cost center so finance can track savings.

sam: Will do. Closing thread once canary completes successfully.
